Implement is in several respects stricter than the embedded checker (initial defaults, incarnation tokens, patch minimality); the F2/F4 disagreement is asymmetric, not a strict weakening.
findings: F1 blocker — o23-trace-patches-control-build.py:56-59 source_only(): `return k.startswith((...))` followed by an unparenthesized `or k in (...)` continuation is a SyntaxError; the module cannot be imported, so inspect_cases and all seven controls are dead. recovered-proposals.json independently records python_syntax:false for sha f4c221cf. Minimal fix: parenthesize the boolean (as in a_domain.source_only).

F2 interop/coverage — implement _trace (rows block ~lines221-229, prefixes block ~lines230-236) binds only index/state-sha/action per side; it never re-derives row['q_invoked']→invocations nor prefixes[i]['differing_journal_fields']. The embedded checker does both (~lines122,133-134 and ~145-148). run_controls(cases, inspect_cases, charge) is signature-compatible with either inspect_cases: injected with the implement checker, controls invocation-mask-forgery, rehashed-journal-field-loss and prefix-journal-diff-forgery escape. Fixture: deepcopy of a passing case with rows[0].q_invoked flipped → implement 'supported', embedded checker 'counterexample'. Minimal fix: joint per-prefix pass recomputing DIFF_FIELDS diff and q_invoked-derived invocations.

F3 crash-instead-of-refusal — control-build computes profile['actions'].index(a) (~line130) and q_actions.index(a) (~line135) without membership guards; the schema except catches only KeyError/IndexError/TypeError/AttributeError (~lines162-164), so ValueError aborts the whole run. Reachable fixtures: source actions containing an element outside profile['actions'] (no inventory check; implement has 'action-inventory'), or a row q_invoked=True on a source-only action with a matching adapter invocations patch. run_controls locate() lambdas also dereference cases[0] unguarded. Minimal fix: membership guard or add ValueError to the except.

F4 premise asymmetry — control-build validates frames only against supplied `initial` key sets (~lines137-142) and never checks canonical initial values, incarnation tokens, tuple field types, or patch minimality; implement checks all of these (DEFAULTS/invocations at ~lines190-199, _fields ~81-112, _apply ~115-143). Same malformed bytes (e.g., nonempty adapter initial journal.attempts with a consistent claimed prefix-0 diff) yield 'supported' from the embedded checker and 'counterexample' from implement. Additionally implement's `import semantic` (~lines36-38) transitively executes s_domain's module-level profile construction and imports q_audit, beyond its stated representation-only reuse.
